Pull Request Template
Fixes #issue_number

What was changed?
Describe what part of the application was changed (e.g., login page, database, etc.). Mention specific components that were added, removed, or modified.

Example:

Updated the login form layout and validation logic.
Why was it changed?
Explain the problem or issue that prompted this change. Detail why this change effectively resolves the issue or improves the application.

Example:

The login form was updated to enhance user experience and improve security measures.
How was it changed?
Detail the key modifications in the codebase, highlighting significant files, functions, or lines of code.

Example:

Refactored the form validation logic in login.js file to include real-time feedback.
Screenshots that show the changes (if applicable):
Include screenshots or visual representations of the changes, especially for user interface updates.

Before:
Attach screenshot
